purpose: Checks whether compact observations support returning to a product after a delayed question reveals the required field; not a headline scorecard.

newCases.description: recover a collapsed full-specification value from the target product after the delayed question
control: recover a visible specification value from the target product after the delayed question

command: AGENT_SUITE=revisit-v1 AGENT_APPROACHES=mantis,tree,screenshot AGENT_RUNS=1 AGENT_MAX_STEPS=50 AGENT_V2_STANDARD_MAX_STEPS=50 npm run bench:agent
